observation.command: echo "=== cgroup memory ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.current 2>/dev/null; echo "=== cgroup v1? ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes 2>/dev/null; echo "=== dmesg oom (case-insensitive) ==="; dmesg 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "out of memory|oom|killed process|memory cgroup" | tail -5; echo "rc=$?"; echo "=== memory.oom.group / events ==="; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events 2>/dev/null
